HediffDef.label: <color=#E85A7A>因果相连</color>
HediffDef.description: Gains Karma through Death Sentence. Healing and resurrection create up to 6 Karma Links lasting 30 days; living links can substitute for death. Recruited death growth caps at 10 deaths. Without a substitute, returns after 10 days.

HediffDef.label: <color=#B86CFF>代偿因果</color>
HediffDef.description: 该目标正在替<color=#E85A7A>昭离</color>承担一层溢出的<color=#B86CFF>因果</color>。在这层因果消失之前，无法再次替昭离承担新的溢出因果。
